description: This file manages follow-up queue draining logic, including scheduling, callbacks, and processing queued follow-up messages in a chat or messaging system.

methods.name: rememberFollowupDrainCallback
methods.description: Stores a callback function for follow-up drain associated with a specific key.

methods.name: clearFollowupDrainCallback
methods.description: Removes the stored callback for a specific follow-up drain key.

methods.name: kickFollowupDrainIfIdle
methods.description: Restarts the drain process for a given key if it is currently idle, using the stored callback.

methods.name: scheduleFollowupDrain
methods.description: Initiates the draining process for follow-up messages associated with a specific key, handling queue processing and callbacks.
